purpose: Machine-readable inventory and new-project adaptation policy. Human guides: docs/orchestration/PROJECT_MAP.md and PROJECT_MAP.ko.md.
coverage: Every tracked distribution path must match at least one category path or adapt-and-rewrite file.

research-workspace.action: keep — this is the research project's working space

shared-orchestration-core.action: keep while the selected agent system is in use

provider-orchestration-core.action: keep the selected provider; the unselected provider is removable after init

template-dev-only.action: review, then delete in a real research project unless maintaining this template

notes..github/: template distribution CI; replace with project CI
notes.docs/: template usage and maintainer guides; read PROJECT_MAP before deletion
notes.setup.sh: one-line init wrapper; optional after initialization

adaptation-support.action: keep until adaptation is complete; optional afterward

adapt-and-rewrite.action: keep the file but truncate or rewrite template content for the new project

README.ko.md.advice: replace with the project's Korean README or delete it

LICENSE.advice: choose the project's license and copyright holder

requirements.txt.advice: keep one dependency file and replace template-test dependencies with project dependencies

.gitignore.advice: review data, checkpoint, run-output, paper, and secret policies for this project

run.sh.advice: implement the reproducible project training/experiment entrypoint

evaluate.sh.advice: implement the project evaluation entrypoint and metric checks

plan/PRD.md.advice: fill in the user-approved research PRD with the root orchestrator

plan/CHECKLIST.md.advice: fill in the evidence-linked project checklist with the root orchestrator
